conditioning: Same parent program S0_REFERENCE_REPLAY, same operator pointwise, same representation bridge, same window [0.1,0.5], same dose (native_rms_ratio 0.66, pointcloud_delta_A 1.0, max_atom_step_A 0.15), same controller unit_rms, same coordinate_updates_only. Only the region changes: F_b011_s030__reference (20 atom slots, 6 pocket sites, 3 orientation triplets) versus F_b011_s030__NC (3 atom slots 6/13/22, 6 pocket sites, 1 orientation triplet). The NC support is a single aromatic ring fragment (C6, C13, N22) whose pocket-field distances in F_b011_s030__NC/regional_context are reported as source terminal chemistry, not as proven contacts or energies. The evidence clock domain is the complete learning_window [0.0,0.5], distinct from the control window.
contrast_definition: Single-factor region swap at fixed parent program and fixed operator: S0_REFERENCE_REPLAY with region F_b011_s030__NC versus S0_REFERENCE_REPLAY with region F_b011_s030__reference. Both are from-zero pools scored on the same 24-candidate set with tau 8.135048866271973. The comparison is between two region-conditioned local supports under an otherwise identical program; it is not a comparison of absolute suffix affinity with from-zero pools, and it is not a claim that the source layout score forecasts generated outcomes.
falsifier: The hypothesis is falsified if, under the same parent program, operator, representation, window and dose, the NC region produces a terminal affinity distribution that is not worse than the reference region on the primary frozen-tail utility and affinity mean guard, for example U_tau at least as large as the reference U_tau 0.01245729128519694 with mean_all_pic50 at least 7.827488899230957 and best_qualified_pic50 at least 8.4340238571167, or if the NC region attains at least one candidate above tau 8.135048866271973. It is also falsified if the NC region's execution response shows assignment switching or clipping comparable to the reference region rather than the recorded near-zero values, which would remove the proposed geometric mechanism.
observable_definition: Implemented and derivative-tested: local Hungarian assignment, robust per-point distance to observed teacher coordinates. Units A; no chemical-role or energy assumption.

scientific_hypothesis: Restricting the local pointwise support to the three-atom aromatic fragment (slots 6, 13, 22) in region F_b011_s030__NC changes the terminal affinity distribution relative to the 20-slot reference region under the same parent program. The mechanism under test is that a smaller, chemically coherent local support reduces assignment ambiguity and spurious long-range point matching, so the retained local geometry is more often compatible with the terminal teacher target. This is a geometric hypothesis about local support size and coherence; it does not assert a hydrogen-bond role, an interaction energy, or a causal internal model module.
